releaseNotes.zh-CN:
• 月薪可按当月排班的上班天数折算日薪，新增「每月日薪」页查看本月日历与后三个月。
• 加班可选计薪或不计薪，并设定倍数（1×、1.5×、2×、3× 或自订）；薪资设置新增加班默认。
• 加班可选择「到几点」或「加多久」，并可先休息再开始；计时页显示已加班时长和计薪说明。
• 记录中可为某天补记或修改加班时段、计入工时和计薪方式。
releaseNotes.en:
• Monthly pay can be divided by each month's scheduled workdays, with a new Daily pay by month page showing this month and the next three.
• Choose whether overtime is paid and at what multiple (1×, 1.5×, 2×, 3× or custom), with a default in Salary settings.
• Set overtime until a time or for how long, with an optional rest first. The timer shows overtime worked and how it is paid.
• Add or edit a past day's overtime in Records: its period, counted hours and pay.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: • 关于页同步 iOS 的 fi_niaR Studio 品牌字标，适配浅色、深色及大字号；减少动画时光标保持常亮。
releaseNotes.en: • Updated About with the iOS fi_niaR Studio wordmark, supporting light and dark themes and larger text. The cursor stays lit with reduced motion.

releaseNotes.zh-CN: • 修复休息倒计时的进度气泡在接近起点或终点时被截断的问题，百分比与指针现在可完整显示。
releaseNotes.en: • Fixed the rest countdown progress bubble being clipped near either end of the bar. The percentage and pointer now remain fully visible.

releaseNotes.zh-CN:
• 新增多种桌面小组件，查看下班倒计时、工时汇总、人生、专注、假期，以及大小周与排班周概览；可在应用内预览和添加。
• 优化小组件的默认尺寸、布局与倒计时显示，适配 Android 启动器。
• 更新首次欢迎页与小组件介绍，修复欢迎页时间滚动显示。
• 致谢内容默认折叠，可按需展开查看。
releaseNotes.en:
• Add Home Screen widgets for shift countdowns, work-hour summaries, life, focus, holidays, and alternating-week or roster overviews. Preview and add them in the app.
• Improve default widget sizes, layouts, and countdown rendering for Android launchers.
• Refresh the welcome screens and widget introduction, and fix the rolling time display during setup.
• Keep acknowledgements collapsed until you choose to expand them.

releaseNotes.zh-CN:
• 新增启动后的版本检查，有新版时提醒你；同一版本的提醒最多每七天出现一次。
• 更新提示展示本次改进，关于页可离线查看更新日志。
• 检查结果在原行显示，页面不再跳动。
• 关于页统一工作室品牌样式，展示 APP 备案信息。
releaseNotes.en:
• Check for updates on launch and receive a reminder when a new version is available, at most once per week for the same version.
• Read release notes in the update prompt or offline in About.
• Update status stays in its row without shifting the page.
• About uses the studio branding and displays the app registration.

releaseNotes.zh-CN:
• 新增手动检查更新和官方下载入口。
• 关于页新增工作室品牌与 APP 备案信息。
releaseNotes.en:
• Added manual update checks and the official download link.
• Added studio branding and app registration in About.
